name: game-end-rewind-unarchive
description: An accidental End Game stays rewindable (live pbd346, pbd303: rewound past /game end archive_channels, the channels stayed in 'The in-limbo PBD Archive', hidden from the bot: every answer 500 and the game could not be ended again). pbd229@370 (status homework): end the game with archive_channels, rewind (web) to before the end: the tabletalk/actions channels must be back out of the archive, a normal answer must work (start the strategy phase, pick a card) and the game must end (and archive) again. Fix: bot GameUndoService restores the channels of an un-ended game (UnendedGameChannels), shim un-archives a channel moved out of the archive category and its sweep never re-archives a game that is not finished.
